originalSourceText:
Q.5  A student claims: “AMCL and SLAM perform exactly the same localization task
      because both estimate robot position”. What is the best correction?

      (A) AMCL builds the occupancy map, whereas SLAM only generates velocity
      commands.

      (B) SLAM simultaneously builds a map and estimates position, whereas AMCL
       estimates pose using an existing occupancy map.

      (C) SLAM is exclusively a visualization tool, whereas AMCL is a simulator.

      (D) AMCL performs global planning, whereas SLAM performs local planning.

       Explanation: The key distinction is that SLAM couples mapping with localization,
      whereas AMCL performs pose estimation using LiDAR, an occupancy map, and
      odometry.

      Refer slides12, 22 of lecture 58: Demonstration in ROS
